name: dsh-job-watch
description: DSH Web GUI: attach a long-running job id to the CURRENT conversation and let the sidebar row carry its state — pink while the job runs, green once it finished (come back and analyse), amber when the id cannot be found. Providers are just a shell command plus one regex, so anything that can list what is running (an HPC scheduler, tmux on a bare-metal box, your own CLI) works. Not affiliated with DeepSeek.
